asked.item: Can private replies be sent to the main inbox instead of Message Requests
Why replies land in Message Requests (person has not messaged the Page before)
What can be done so people find the message

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that Facebook decides where a private reply lands and Blotato cannot change it, and they give the page's own workaround.

steps.text: Blotato cannot change where a private reply lands, because Facebook decides that.
Facebook can put a private reply in Message Requests when the person has not messaged your Page before.
To help people find the message, use the automation's public reply to tell them to check Message Requests.
